description:
Château de Lalande is a fully restored 18th-19th-century château beside the Isle river valley, 12 km from Périgueux. The original main house, known as the "Petit Château," dates to the 18th century.

Today its 17 quiet, very comfortable rooms, including 6 suites and junior suites, each with air conditioning and personalized decor, are all within the Petit Château.

The estate's designation as a "Petit Château" alongside its 18th-19th-century construction history suggests a once-larger complex, of which this main house is the surviving and restored core.

The property's membership in Les Collectionneurs, a curated French hotel collection formerly known as Châteaux & Hôtels Collection, ties Lalande to a broader network of independently owned heritage properties.

The estate's centenary wisteria-covered pool terrace gives the property a distinctive, long-established garden feature alongside its restored historic architecture.

The château's position just 12 km from Périgueux gives guests staying at Lalande easy access to one of the Dordogne's most significant historic cities.
